Three boxes to tick: product ownership, partner-driven platforms, and modernising a legacy core without breaking the service.

Product Owner – Registration & Domain Lifecycle | Brussels

Our client is a European, technology-driven organisation that operates a registration platform its partners rely on every single day.

Its product is a lifecycle: a name is registered, renewed, transferred, suspended or released, millions of times over, through a network of accredited partners and under rules it does not set alone.

That platform is now being modernised, moving from a legacy core towards the next generation of registration services, without a single interruption to the service partners depend on.

To drive this, the organisation is looking for a Product Owner to own the vision, the roadmap and the backlog of this platform.

 

The job

• Own the vision, roadmap and backlog of the registration platform and of the lifecycle capabilities built on top of it.
• Translate partner needs, operational realities and regulatory obligations into clear product direction, and make transparent trade-offs between value, urgency, risk and delivery capacity.
 
Role
• Define and maintain the roadmap across the core registration platform, registration APIs, domain-name lifecycle and data analytics capabilities.
• Own and structure the backlog, balancing immediate service improvements against modernisation, resilience and long-term sustainability.
• Give clear product direction to the Business Analysts, validate functional requirements and acceptance criteria, and own functional acceptance through to go/no-go release decisions.
• Work closely with Business Owners and with the engineering, architecture, service delivery, compliance and security teams to keep requirements understood, feasible and aligned.
• Track adoption, usability and service quality, and turn what the numbers show into roadmap decisions.
Profile
• 7+ years in technology-driven products or services, with real ownership as a Product Owner or Product Manager.
• Domain-name ecosystem knowledge (EPP, WHOIS/RDAP, DNS) is a big plus; experience on regulated, partner-driven platforms — telecom, payments, utilities — works just as well.
• You know how to modernise a legacy core without disrupting daily service.
• Excellent written and spoken English.
